actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE newly drawn genuine walking animation frame for the exact same chibi Daoist calligrapher boy. Reference 1 is the approved N rear-facing idle: lock its identity, rear costume construction, hand assignment, giant brush and scroll shapes, head/body proportions, subject scale, camera, and drawing detail. Reference 2 shows original identity from front; reference 3 gives the approved polished Chinese fantasy illustration style only. This frame faces due NORTH straight away from camera, back fully visible, no face. Anatomical RIGHT hand/image-right holds giant black-jade-gold calligraphy brush with downward white bristles; anatomical LEFT hand/image-left holds the hanging pale scroll with black-gold rollers and two little pale blue spirit companions. Brown tousled topknot, teal ribbon, warm black robe with gold cloud borders, white inner robe, teal lining and belt, black-gold boots. The round yin-yang head badge and belt buckle belong on the FRONT and remain hidden from the rear: no face or forehead mark or front buckle on back.
Camera and framing MUST match approved reference 1 exactly: mild top-down orthographic game view, complete figure centered, square canvas minimum 1024x1024 native, top of hair near y=7%, lowest planted foot near y=94%, generous side margins. Draw real anatomy, both separate feet visible below robe, not running or jumping, at least one grounded support foot. Keep prop motion small and scale stable. Transparent PNG actual alpha, no floor or cast shadow, no colored outline, no labels/text/grid. One complete single pose only. Do not use mirror, interpolation, distortion, duplication or translation of another pose.
WALK N FRAME 01/16 at cycle time 0%. RIGHT leg forward initial contact, LEFT leg back at toe-off. Viewed from behind: right boot is advanced away from viewer and slightly higher on image, its heel touches ground and toe begins to lower; left boot trails toward viewer and image-lower, left heel clearly lifted with forefoot/toe still touching ground. Legs remain on own anatomical sides, never cross. Weight begins transfer to the right foot. Body upright, slight natural counter-rotation, robe hem separates enough to reveal this asymmetric two-foot stride. This is a clear genuine walking contact pose, visibly different from neutral idle.

prompt.txt.exact_text: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE completely new genuine articulated walking frame of the exact 灵篆书生 calligrapher boy. Image 1 is the approved NE idle and defines exact rear-three-quarter camera, identity, scale and equipment. Image 2 is the original identity portrait. The last image is the approved primary polished Q-Daoist hand-painted style reference only. Keep huge round head, short compact body and limbs, brown tousled topknot, teal trailing ribbon, charcoal warm-black robe with ornate gold cloud trim, white inner robe, teal lining and sash, short black-gold boots. Anatomical RIGHT hand on near/image-right side holds the identical giant black/jade/gold brush with ivory bristles down. Anatomical LEFT hand on far/image-left holds the blank pale scroll with black-gold rollers and exactly two pale-blue ghost companions. Never swap hands. Head badge and belt medallion are on FRONT, hidden from rear. Fixed NORTHEAST direction: 45 degrees between due north away and due east image-right. We see the back of head and robe and his right side, only tiny right ear/cheek sliver, never a front eye. Both toes point upper-right. Fixed mild top-down orthographic camera, no camera zoom or turn. Match image1 hair-to-boot height, head size and boot size. Complete figure centered with hair at y7%, lowest support sole at y94%, all brush, scroll, ribbons and spirits inside safe margins. Native square single image at least1024x1024.  WALK NE FRAME 10/16, cycle phase 9/16. REQUIRED LEG ACTION: Left heel rolls nearly flat into weight acceptance; left knee begins to flex, right rear toe is just leaving the ground. In this NE rear-three-quarter view, FORWARD means away toward upper-right and BACK means toward lower-left. The anatomical RIGHT leg is nearer/image-right and the LEFT leg is farther/image-left; never exchange them. Show two distinct feet below parted robe hem. This is restrained ordinary walking, not running, marching, kicking or jumping; at least one support sole/toe touches ground. Keep props steady with subtle small natural cloth and ribbon response. Transparent PNG genuine alpha, no floor, cast shadow, colored fringe, checkerboard, text, labels, grid or multiple poses. Draw new articulated anatomy; never copy, mirror, interpolate, warp or translate a previous pose. Critical unambiguous SCREEN-SPACE arrangement: the TRAILING or airborne boot is on the RIGHT HALF OF THE IMAGE, below the brush hand at x62%, with its heel raised and dark sole facing viewer at y93%. The FORWARD PLANTED boot is on the LEFT HALF OF THE IMAGE below the scroll hand at x44%, smaller in depth at y87%, with gold heel but NO visible dark sole. Keep the legs separate and traceable. Exactly the image-RIGHT boot shows its dark underside; the image-LEFT boot does not. This reverses the leg phase of early frames while leaving all upper-body equipment unchanged.

Image1 locks exact identity; Image2 is exact SE standing scale and camera design; Image3 is the MAIN approved clean rounded hand-painted Daoist Q art style, ignore its UI. The character is facing SOUTHEAST, front-right three-quarter 45 degrees, diagonally down-right. Both eyes visible with far eye smaller. Mildly elevated orthographic game camera. Keep identical brown spiky bun hair, yin-yang hairpin and teal ribbon, jade forehead diamond, large brown eyes and round face, gold-cloud charcoal robe, ivory inside, teal lining, yin-yang jade belt, short pants, black gold-trimmed boots. ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand on SCREEN-LEFT holds huge brush; ANATOMICAL LEFT hand on SCREEN-RIGHT holds ivory blank scroll with black/gold rollers. Exactly TWO cyan ink spirits around scroll. The scroll MUST have its small hanging yin-yang medallion and short teal tassel, with tip ABOVE both boot soles so it never defines ground anchor. Never omit or swap equipment. Frame 05 of sixteen-frame 480 ms normal walking loop. Specific physical pose: RIGHT planted support and LEFT passing. Near RIGHT boot at screen-left is the sole weight-bearing foot, flat at lowest ground level, visibly larger and LOWER. Far LEFT boot at screen-right is LIFTED about 70 native pixels ABOVE right sole, close alongside ankle, knee flexed. Do not plant screen-right boot. Planted right boot is rooted at x48% y94%; lifted left boot x60% y88%. Near RIGHT hip is on screen-left, far LEFT hip screen-right. Boots must connect to the proper hips, never switch their side identities. Newly articulate the whole pose with natural weight-bearing hip and knee positions. At least one foot contacts ground; no flying, jump, sprint, big knees, seated pose or squatting. Small natural arm counter-swing, slight robe/tassel response. Keep head, brush, scroll, body scale and camera nearly unchanged from Image2. All toes point down-right, not outward. Whole figure including hair, brush, spirits, scroll and boots fits comfortably in one square native1024x1024 or larger canvas. Transparent alpha background. Clean soft antialiased edge, no colored fringe, no floor, no shadows, no text, grid or montage. Round bright clean high detail hand-painted volume, not plastic. Independently redraw this exact pose; do not duplicate, mirror, stretch, translate or interpolate another frame.

prompt.txt.exact_text: Use case: identity-preserve. Generate ONE newly painted complete standalone 2D game animation sprite, a square native image at least 1024x1024, with genuine alpha transparency. Image1 is the exact identity; Image2 is the same-direction idle defining scale, camera and costume; any additional character image is a gait continuity reference only; the last image is the approved primary hand-painted style reference. Preserve this exact 灵篆书生 boy: huge round head, short compact limbs and body, brown tousled straight hair and topknot with teal/gold yin-yang clasp, brown eyes, jade forehead diamond, ivory inner robe, charcoal-black short outer robe with antique-gold cloud trim and teal lining, yin-yang belt and jade tassels, short dark gold-trimmed boots. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds ONE black/gold/teal brush, LEFT hand holds ONE blank ivory scroll with black/gold rollers; exactly TWO cyan ink spirits close to scroll. Keep original hands and ornament arrangement. Fixed orthographic slightly elevated RPG camera. Match Image2 figure/head size exactly, no camera move or zoom: top hair at about 8% of height, lowest boots at96%, body axis50%. Full extremities and accessories inside canvas, clear margin, tassels always above lowest boot. Maintain the clean rounded finely painted Q-Daoist style and luminous restrained materials; no plastic 3D, realism or altered identity.  View S/front, face and body square toward viewer. Anatomical right leg appears on viewer LEFT, anatomical left leg on viewer RIGHT. This is walk S13, phase 12/16 in a 16-pose cycle. REQUIRED articulated leg pose: PASSING pose. Left foot planted beneath hip, right knee and foot pass beside left leg without crossing or merging; right foot hovers low. Head at neutral height. At least one foot always bears weight on the ground. Short relaxed ordinary walking stride; no running, jumping, high-knee march, kick, huge forward sole, crossed legs or sliding duplicated pose. Boots keep same size as idle; toe direction follows body. Adjust knees, hips, ankles, robe folds and subtle opposite torso sway coherently, with secure steady props and face. Do not alter body/head scale. Draw a unique articulated pose at this phase; no copying, mirroring, stretching or whole-sprite translation. Completely transparent empty background, no floor, cast shadow, checkerboard, halo, text, caption, numbering, UI, grid or multiple people.

actual_parameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Draw ONE native new W walk frame 07/16. Image1 fixes the exact directional camera, character scale, head/torso/boot proportions, held objects and costume. Image2 fixes original identity. Image3 is the main approved hand-painted STYLE. Absolute WEST camera: the boy faces exactly SCREEN LEFT in a pure side profile, nose and both boots point left; show only one eye, never a three-quarter front view. The anatomical LEFT side is the near side and left hand holds the scroll; anatomical RIGHT hand holds the brush on the far side, partly visible. Do not exchange held objects. Gait requirement: RIGHT back foot pushes from its toe, toe still grounded. LEFT leg swings forward with softly bent knee, left boot ahead and low, no large exposed shoe sole. The near side leg is anatomical LEFT; the far leg is anatomical RIGHT. Forward travel is SCREEN LEFT. Maintain the pure side torso and thin edge of the front waist buckle from Image1. Keep the short chibi anatomy and body size exactly stable, both legs connected to their own hips, normal grounded tiny walking stride, never flying. Clothing and ribbons follow this new phase subtly. Right hand holds black-jade-gold brush and white bristles down, left hand ivory scroll with black-gold rollers, two cyan ghosts beside scroll; never switch or mirror equipment. Brown topknot, teal ribbons/jade beads, black-gold embroidered robe and ivory lining all unchanged. Full figure same scale as Image1 about92% square height; preserve safe margins around all props. Native1254x1254 square or greater, minimum1024, genuine transparent RGBA with clean naturally colored edges, no chromatic halo, no floor/shadow/text/checkerboard/grid. One newly hand-painted complete action; no mirror, warp, interpolation, repeated idle or translated frozen pose. Image4 is the existing phase05 and Image5 is phase09, both are pose-scale guides only. Draw this requested NEW phase, not either reference pose. Preserve correct near/far depth: RIGHT far smaller boot supports from behind; LEFT near larger boot swings FORWARD screen-left at low height and gradually descends toward its contact. Near LEFT thigh occludes FAR right thigh where they overlap. Boot physical size stays consistent with idle, only modest near/far perspective, never giant boots. Keep at least one genuine support foot grounded, no both-feet-off-floor pose.

Absolute NORTHWEST camera: the boy faces diagonally AWAY toward SCREEN UPPER LEFT, rear-left 45-degree view showing his back and a narrow left cheek at most. No frontal chest or frontal belt buckle on his back. Preserve anatomical LEFT hand holding the scroll on the near/left side and anatomical RIGHT hand holding brush on the far/right side; do not exchange objects. Gait requirement: RIGHT foot remains planted as the torso progresses over it. LEFT knee bends and the left foot lifts low, coming from behind toward the right ankle, no crossing of anatomical leg lanes. Near leg is anatomical LEFT, far leg anatomical RIGHT. Forward travel is diagonally UPPER LEFT. In right-leading first-half gait, right boot advances up-left below robe while left leg trails DOWN-RIGHT toward viewer; do not always draw the left boot leading. Keep back gold knot/sash from Image1. Keep the short chibi anatomy and body size exactly stable, both legs connected to their own hips, normal grounded tiny walking stride, never flying. Clothing and ribbons follow this new phase subtly. Right hand holds black-jade-gold brush and white bristles down, left hand ivory scroll with black-gold rollers, two cyan ghosts beside scroll; never switch or mirror equipment. Brown topknot, teal ribbons/jade beads, black-gold embroidered robe and ivory lining all unchanged. Full figure same scale as Image1 about92% square height; preserve safe margins around all props. Native1254x1254 square or greater, minimum1024, genuine transparent RGBA with clean naturally colored edges, no chromatic halo, no floor/shadow/text/checkerboard/grid. One newly hand-painted complete action; no mirror, warp, interpolation, repeated idle or translated frozen pose. Image4 is the existing phase01 and Image5 is phase05, both are pose-scale guides only. Draw this requested NEW phase, not either reference pose. Preserve correct near/far depth: RIGHT far leg supports forward; smaller right boot is forward screen-left/high. LEFT near leg is trailing screen-right/low and larger, then lifting into swing. Near LEFT thigh occludes FAR right thigh where they overlap. Boot physical size stays consistent with idle, only modest near/far perspective, never giant boots. Keep at least one genuine support foot grounded, no both-feet-off-floor pose.

actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete full-body high-resolution transparent PNG sprite of the exact same chibi Daoist calligrapher boy from reference image 1, for an eight-direction RPG character animation. Reference image 2 is only the established clean polished Chinese fantasy painting/material style; reference image 3 establishes the character identity, head/body proportions, equipment size, and full-body standing scale.

This image is N IDLE: the boy faces exactly away from camera, due north, with his back toward us and both feet resting naturally on the same ground plane. Camera is fixed mild top-down orthographic game view. Show back of brown tousled hair and topknot with teal ribbon; do not put a front-facing face or forehead jewel on the back of his head. Preserve black warm-brown robe with ornate gold cloud embroidery, white inner robe, teal lining, jade-and-gold ornaments, black/gold boots, round large head and short body. His anatomical RIGHT hand holds the same giant black/jade/gold calligraphy brush, now on the IMAGE RIGHT in rear view; its white bristles hang downward. His anatomical LEFT hand holds the same hanging pale scroll with black and gold rollers, now on the IMAGE LEFT in rear view; render its proper rear/side surfaces and retain the two little pale blue ghost companions. No swapping hands, no mirror copy.

Independent relaxed stationary pose, feet separated slightly, no walking stride. Keep full character centered at image x=50%, feet ground plane y=94%, crown near y=7%, body proportions and subject height matching reference 3. Maintain complete brush, scroll, ribbons, spirits and boots inside the frame with safe margins. Single character, single frame, square canvas at least 1024x1024 native resolution, transparent alpha background, no contact shadow, no grid, no text, no borders. Draw a new genuine rear-facing pose, never a transformed front pose. Crisp clean alpha edges without colored fringes.
CORRECTION EMPHASIS: The back of the headpiece shows plain gold/teal fastening and the tied ribbon only. The round yin-yang head badge faces FORWARD and is completely occluded in this REAR view: do not show that badge. The yin-yang belt buckle and hanging front beads are also on his FRONT and hidden from rear; show a plain continuous teal-and-gold belt across his lower back and the rear robe panel. Do not duplicate frontal shoulder dangling ornaments on the back. The rear is not a front torso pasted under rear hair. Preserve anatomical right brush/image-right and left scroll/image-left.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete full-body high-resolution transparent PNG sprite of the exact same chibi Daoist calligrapher boy from reference image 1, for an eight-direction RPG character animation. Reference image 2 is only the established clean polished Chinese fantasy painting/material style; reference image 3 establishes the character identity, head/body proportions, equipment size, and full-body standing scale.

This image is N IDLE: the boy faces exactly away from camera, due north, with his back toward us and both feet resting naturally on the same ground plane. Camera is fixed mild top-down orthographic game view. Show back of brown tousled hair and topknot with teal ribbon; do not put a front-facing face or forehead jewel on the back of his head. Preserve black warm-brown robe with ornate gold cloud embroidery, white inner robe, teal lining, jade-and-gold ornaments, black/gold boots, round large head and short body. His anatomical RIGHT hand holds the same giant black/jade/gold calligraphy brush, now on the IMAGE RIGHT in rear view; its white bristles hang downward. His anatomical LEFT hand holds the same hanging pale scroll with black and gold rollers, now on the IMAGE LEFT in rear view; render its proper rear/side surfaces and retain the two little pale blue ghost companions. No swapping hands, no mirror copy.

Independent relaxed stationary pose, feet separated slightly, no walking stride. Keep full character centered at image x=50%, feet ground plane y=94%, crown near y=7%, body proportions and subject height matching reference 3. Maintain complete brush, scroll, ribbons, spirits and boots inside the frame with safe margins. Single character, single frame, square canvas at least 1024x1024 native resolution, transparent alpha background, no contact shadow, no grid, no text, no borders. Draw a new genuine rear-facing pose, never a transformed front pose. Crisp clean alpha edges without colored fringes.
CORRECTION EMPHASIS: The back of the headpiece shows plain gold/teal fastening and the tied ribbon only. The round yin-yang head badge faces FORWARD and is completely occluded in this REAR view: do not show that badge. The yin-yang belt buckle and hanging front beads are also on his FRONT and hidden from rear; show a plain continuous teal-and-gold belt across his lower back and the rear robe panel. Do not duplicate frontal shoulder dangling ornaments on the back. The rear is not a front torso pasted under rear hair. Preserve anatomical right brush/image-right and left scroll/image-left.

actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete high-resolution full-body transparent PNG RPG character sprite, independent NE IDLE pose.
Reference 1 is the approved N rear view of this exact calligrapher boy and defines the back costume, hands, proportions and subject scale. Reference 2 is his original identity portrait. Reference 3 is approved polished Q-style Chinese fantasy illustration material quality only.
Rotate the ACTUAL character into exactly NORTHEAST, 45 degrees between straight-away NORTH and image-right EAST. He stands calmly looking away toward upper-right. We see a rear three-quarter view: back of hair, back of robe and his right-side silhouette; only a tiny sliver of right cheek/ear may appear, no front-facing eyes looking at camera. Feet point upper-right and rest naturally side by side on the ground, no walking stride.
Preserve brown messy topknot, teal ribbon, black warm-brown robe with ornate gold cloud embroidery, white inner robe, teal robe lining and sash, black-and-gold boots. Exact identity, round large head, short body. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the SAME giant black/jade/gold calligraphy brush on the near/right side, its ivory bristles downward; anatomical LEFT hand holds the SAME hanging pale scroll with black-and-gold rollers on the far/left side, foreshortened naturally but still recognizable, with both pale-blue little ghost companions. Never swap hands. Front-facing yin-yang head badge and belt medallion are obscured by this rear view; do not paste them onto the back.
Fixed mild top-down orthographic game camera, centered, match reference1 overall body HEIGHT and head SIZE exactly; turning must not enlarge character. Square native image at least1024x1024, hair crown near y7%, planted soles near y94%, all props/ribbons/spirits within safe canvas margins. Genuine transparent alpha, no shadow/ground, no border/grid/labels/text. Draw a genuine rear-three-quarter pose, no mirroring or rotation of a flat picture. Crisp clean edges.
